name: dappled-shadows-freckled-girl-coffee
image_purpose: Casual park and coffee social post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical park selfie of a clearly approved adult, preserving freckles, playful eye-roll, coffee, tailored black outfit, and dappled sunlight.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly approved adult woman with fair complexion and natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, light eyes looking upward in a playful eye-roll, light-brown or dirty-blonde hair tied back with curtain-bang strands, wearing a black tailored blazer, white collared shirt, loose black necktie, and black skirt. Hold a clear cup of iced coffee with a straw.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle selfie with arm extended, close vertical framing, paved park path with cobblestone drainage edges, green wooden benches, stone bridge with stairs, leafy canopy, and people walking in the distance. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight filtered through trees, distinct dappled shadows on the path and clothing, realistic pores and fabric texture, playful candid atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, high-angle perspective, vertical 9:16, 4K detail, natural depth, no heavy filtering.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 high-angle park selfie of a clearly approved adult woman with fair complexion and natural freckles across her nose and cheeks, light eyes looking upward in a playful eye-roll, light-brown or dirty-blonde hair tied back with loose curtain-bang strands. She wears a black tailored blazer, white collared shirt, loose black necktie, and black skirt, holding a clear iced-coffee cup with a straw. Paved park promenade with cobblestone drainage edges, rows of green wooden benches, stone bridge and stairs, leafy canopy, and distant walkers. Bright daylight filtered through trees, dappled shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, candid playful mood.
